content: If interrupts have to be disabled in order to ensure data consistency or correct functionality of this module (e.g. while switching the watchdog mode or during the watchdog trigger routine), this shall be done by using the corresponding BSW Scheduler functionality if possible (this means definition of an exclusive area). The i nternal watchdog driver (because it belongs to MCAL) may also directly disable interrupts – see SRS_BSW_00429 .
